title: Teshuvot HaRosh
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: 14th-century responsa composed primarily in Spain with German influences, quoted often by the author’s son, the Tur, and the Shulchan Arukh. Complete Responsa text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Responsa are written answers to specific legal questions, addressed by a scholar to a community or an individual. A responsum is a dated, situated ruling and is presented with its collection rather than as a universal statute.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
